Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray demonstrates a large, well-defined opacity occupying the lower half of the right hemithorax with smooth margins, which is characteristic of a solitary fibrous tumour of the pleura. This appearance correlates with option B, whereas the other options describe incorrect locations (left side, upper zone, mediastinum) or malignant features (irregular/poorly defined margins) not seen here.
